twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Add an extra layer of security to your account
twoFactor.lowBackupCodesWarning: You're running low on backup codes. Consider regenerating them.
twoFactor.notEnabledMessage: Two-factor authentication is not enabled. Enable it below to add extra security to your account.

enable.title: Enable Two-Factor Authentication
enable.totpDescription: Use apps like Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password
enable.scanQR: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app:
enable.manualEntry: Or enter this secret key manually:

disable.title: Disable Two-Factor Authentication
disable.warning: Disabling 2FA will make your account less secure. You'll need to enter your password to confirm.
disable.confirmWarning: Are you sure you want to disable two-factor authentication? This will make your account less secure.

backupCodes.title: Backup Codes
backupCodes.description: Backup codes allow you to access your account if you lose your 2FA device. Each code can only be used once.
backupCodes.regenerateWarning: Regenerating will invalidate all existing backup codes and create 10 new ones.
backupCodes.saveDescription: These codes can be used to access your account if you lose access to your 2FA method. Each code can only be used once.
backupCodes.newCodesDescription: All previous backup codes have been invalidated. Store these new codes in a safe place.
backupCodes.saveInstruction: Store these codes in a safe place. You won't be able to see them again!
